newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine Sept inflation seen at 3-4 pct- adviser.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine Sept inflation seen at 3-4 pct- adviser.

text.p: Ukraine's September inflation was forecast at three to four percent, compared to 5.7 percent in August, President Kuchma's adviser on economic affairs said on Wednesday.
Valery Lytvytsky also said annual inflation for this year would total 48 percent, compared to 182 percent in 1995.
The sharp rise in August was attributed to increases in utility rates and rents. The country achieved record-low inflation levels of 0.1 percent in June and July.
The draft budget, submitted to parliament for approval this week, calls for an annual inflation level of 25 percent in 1997. --Yuri Kulikov, Kiev Newsroom, +380 44 229 2264
